name: lazy-stoner-donator-aekn-transparency

creative_direction.summary: Create one square editorial illustration for a Lazy Stoner Donator campaign/support card.
creative_direction.scene: Cannachris holding six clean question cards toward a public institution building silhouette, scientific transparency, calm pressure, no official logos, no text.
creative_direction.character: Cannachris as a sympathetic tired-but-warm comic activist, focused but friendly, not intoxicated, not angry.
creative_direction.visual_style: same clean comic style as the LSD social asset prompt: crisp outlines, warm skin tones, green cannabis-campaign accents, simple background, readable at card size, no photorealism.
creative_direction.composition: Square card image, centered character, clear symbolic action, generous padding, high contrast, works at small mobile card size.
creative_direction.text_policy: Do not render text, logos, watermarks or fake UI. The card title and button remain HTML text.

required_outputs.purpose: Replacement/upgrade image for the matching campaign/support card
required_outputs.safe_area: Keep character face and core symbol inside the central 900x650 area.

negative_prompt: no extra fingers or distorted hands
quality_checks: works as a normal wishlist card image

seo_metadata.image_alt: Cannachris fordert mit sechs Fragen wissenschaftliche Transparenz zur ÄKN-Cannabis-Resolution ein.
seo_metadata.image_caption: Die ÄKN-Kampagne fragt sachlich nach Quellen, Jugenddaten und wissenschaftlicher Redlichkeit.
